content: Jesús qa te'nekumhi'yi' pa'aj.

Ha' Jesús in yili'ij ekewe'en in iyinijii pa' ƚatata, ma' qa iki'ƚkii he' ƚ'ijatshenhei qu' namiiteje'm ha' ƚajaika' ai hakha' kimi'ik'i ƚ'ikheyi'j na'aj iweli' ƚii Cedrón, hikha' i'ni' ha' wit'enekju' najkaket, qa hikha' qa i'ni'ƚi' ha' Jesús qa he' ƚ'ijatshenhei.
Ka' Judas, kakha' t'ihinij ha' Jesús, nikfe'lii hakha' najkaket, qe hats olotsij qa i'njiiƚi' he' ƚ'ijatshenhei.

Ma' qa ka' Judas qa ƚijts'eyek hekhewe' ewi'ƚ tup'uje'm (grupo) he' hik ƚunyejei oq'opheƚinetsilets witeqjeƚinenheyij ke' qi witlijtsitjii qa hekhewe' uja'x tenek'enhei judiol, nukin hekhewe' tenek'enhe'yij he' pa'il qa hekhewe' iye fariseol. Ma' qa neka'x he' ƚek'ul qa he' ƚefetitjiyits qa ke' ƚaqapjuyititsijup pha'm yenji' ke' najak (antorchas).
Qa ha' Jesús in hayiits week nikfe'lets kakha' ƚunye'jkii, qa ikiju'ƚ, qa nifaakan: —¿Ƚekpa' ƚowo'oƚiikii?—
Hekhewe'en qa yeku'ƚ: —Pa' Jesús, Nazaret ƚeiƚe'.— Jesús qa yit'ij: —Yakha' inek.— Qa ka' Judas, kakha' t'ihinij ha' Jesús, i'nji'teje'm hekhewe'en.
Ha' Jesús in yit'ij: —Yakha' inek— qa week t'oqoyik'uikii qa namiju'kii sehe' hekhewe'en.
Ha' Jesús qa ewi'ƚij iye in nifaakan: —¿Ƚekpa' ƚowo'oƚiikii?— Hekhewe'en qa yit'ijju' iye: —Pa' Jesús, Nazaret ƚeiƚe'.—
Qa ha' Jesús qa yeku'ƚ iye, qa yit'ij: —Hats inek hi'ttaxi'ƚij ewets yakha' inek. Qu' yakha'ye' pakha' ƚowo'oƚiikii, qa' iwejinƚi'iƚ qu' nakkii enewe'en.—
Aka'an hik aka' ƚunye'jkii in yafits kakha' hayiits yit'ij ha' Jesús in yit'ij: —Tata, enewe' ƚesƚisij ham pa'qu' ewii'ƚe' qu' natsqamij.—

Ma' qa ha' Simón Pedro, hikha' na'li'm ha' ƚaqa'tsjikinet, qa nit'ijpha'm qa yifekinij je'm hakha' ƚeqejkunenek ha' qiji' pa'il ƚatata, qa yasinii qa k'itsji' ke' yiya'yik'i te'weiji' ƚekfi'ik'i, ha' witqejkunenek ƚii Malco.
Ha' Jesús qa yit'ijets ha' Pedro: —Ukinik'iju' iye na' ƚejii na' aqa'tsjikinet. Na' Tata in tseƚisij qu' nek'iyaji' na' qi ek'imiiji', ¿me qa' nite' nek'iya'ye'ji'?—
Jesús qa wetka'xii pa' pa'i Anás.

Ma' qa hekhewe' ewi'ƚ tup'uje'm (grupo) he' hik ƚunyejei oq'opheƚinetsilets witeqjeƚinenheyij ke' qi witlijtsitjii, qa hakha' iye yejeƚijipji' hekhewe'en (comandante) qa hekhewe' iye tenek'enhei judíos, qa t'eku'mi' ha' Jesús qa yophe'ƚ.
Ma' qa yojo in yeka'xii ha' Anás, qe hikha' ƚeqewket ha' Caifás, qiji' pa'il ƚatata kakha' ininqa'pji'.
Ha' Caifás hik hakha' yit'ijji'ju' hekhewe' judiol qu' les qu' ƚe'wise'ju' qu' ewi'ƚe' pa'qu' jukhew qu' nawa'mifi ha'ne witset.
Pedro qa welkut'ijkii pa' Jesús.

Ha' Simón Pedro yijayanpha'mkii ha' Jesús in wetka'x qa hakhap iye ƚ'ijatshenek. Hik ha'ne ha' nikfe'li'ƚ wetju'ƚ hakha' qiji' pa'il ƚatata, qa hik ta'ƚijupi' in ƚeke' in yijayanetsji' ha' Jesús hakha' jofji'ju' ke' ƚetsi' ha' pa'il ƚatata.
Qa hakha'ƚe Pedro qa amanfik'i ha' ƚeji'ii. Qa hakha' wit'ijatshenek nikfe'lij ha' qiji' pa'il ƚatata, qa tepiliifik'i iye qa tafaakate'yi'ƚ ke' yejeƚ ha' ƚeji' ma' qa yuihinteje'm iye ha' Pedro.
Ma' qa ke' witqejkunenki' yejeƚ ha' ƚeji', qa nifaakan ha' Pedro: —¿Me nite' hik akha' ha' ewi'ƚ hekhewe' ƚ'ijatshenhei hakha' jukhew?— Ha' Pedro qa yeku'ƚ: —Nite'. Nite' yakha'.—
In k'ui qa hekhewe' ƚeqejkunenhei qa he' witeqjeƚinenheyij ke' witlijtsitjii qa niƚani' ka' ƚefet qa t'aƚets. Qa ha' Pedro qa ts'ap'a'ajup i'nji'teje'm hekhewe'en t'aƚets iye ka' fe't.
Pa' pa'il ƚatata qa nifaakan pa' Jesús.
Ma' qa ha' qiji' pa'il ƚatata qa nifaakanij ha' Jesús in t'ejuyets hekhewe' ƚ'ijatshenhei qa ke' yijatshenij iye.

Ha' Jesús qa yeku'ƚ: —Yakha' in k'iyet nite' hanat'inijik'uikii ene' weekji', k'inq'ijatshenjiifi nekhewe' ƚe'lijtsitjiyits ene' judiol qa k'inq'ijatshenjiifi iye nekhe' qi witlijtsitjii, hik nakha' ƚothewet ne' week judiol, qa ham pakha' qu' hit'ij qu' hanat'inijkii.
¿Inhats'ek in yakha' in ƚatsfaakan? Anfaakan yijat'ij hekhewe' tsepi'ye'ej kekhewe' k'iyetij, hik enewe' nikfe'lets kekhewe' hit'ij.—
Ha' Jesús in yit'ij aka'an, ma' qa ha' ewi'ƚ hekhewe' witeqjeƚinenheyij ke' qi witlijtsitjii qa yilanje'm ƚeju's, qa yit'ij: —¿Me hik aka' pa' i'nanye'j qu' jinteku'ƚ ha'ne qiji' pa'il ƚatata?—
Ha' Jesús qa yeku'ƚ: —Qu' uƚ'axe'ju' pa'qu' hit'ij, enfel ye'm pakha' uƚ'axju' in hit'ij, qa qu' ƚe'wise'ƚeju' in k'iyet, ¿qa inhats'ek in ƚaslan?—
Ma' qa ha' Anás qa inaqyaji'ij qu' newetka'xii ha' Caifás, qiji' pa'il ƚatata, ha' Jesús wo'nophe'ƚ he' ƚokoyei.
Pedro ewi'ƚij iye in welkut'ijkii pa' Jesús.
Ha' Simón Pedro ts'ap'a'ajup ka' fe't, t'aƚets, ma' qa titijiti'yijets: —¿Me nite' hik akha' iye hekhewe' ƚ'ijatshenhei hakha'an?— Ha' Pedro qa welkut'ijkii, qa yit'ij: —Nite', nite' yakha'.—

Ha' ewi'ƚ hekhewe' ƚeqejkunenhei hakha' qiji' pa'il ƚatata, hik hakha' ha' ƚejefe hakha' k'istaxii ke' ƚekfi' yifekinii ha' Pedro, hakha'an qa yit'ijets iye ha' Pedro: —¿Me nite' hik akha' k'eweni' hakha' wit'enekju'ui najkaket, in ijts'ekii hakha'an?—
Ha' Pedro qa ewi'ƚij iye in welkut'ijkii iye, ma' qa hik aka'aj qa ip pa' ta'a'a'.
Jesús qa wetka'xii pa' Pilato.

Ma' qa wetka'xik'uifik'i iye ha' Jesús ke' ƚetsi' ha' Caifás, qa wetka'xii ke' wititsi' ƚii pretorio, Roma ƚakha', i'nifi ek hakha' judiol tenek'enhe'yipji' Roma ƚeiƚe' (gobernador). Mexe leefiju', he' judiol qa nite' uyetsji' ke' wititsi' pretorio, qe tit nuyetsji' ma' titha hats hik ƚunyejeye' qu' netjilii in mexe ƚe'sits pe' neƚuts, qa' nite' ƚeke'ye' qu' na'nij ji'teje'm pakha' witkujiiji' pe' ƚe'sits neƚuts Pascua.
Qa hik ta'ƚijupi' ha' gobernador Pilato in iketsfik'i hekhewe'en, qa yit'ijji'ju': —¿Pa'n ƚunye'j pa' uƚ'ax yaqsiijkii ha'ne jukhew qa ƚenka'xi'ƚmet?—
Hekhewe'en qa yeku'ƚ, qa yit'ijju': —Qu' nite' uƚ'axe' ha'ne jukhew qekha nite' henka'xe'taxi'ƚ ei qu' k'eƚisiƚij.—

Ma' qa ha' Pilato qa yit'ijets iye: —Eka'xi'ƚ nakha'an qa' it'iƚiji' pa' hats ƚ'anye'j pa' eqe leyi'ƚ qu' ekhewele'ƚi'iƚij qu' itanitheni'ƚij nakha'an pa' yaqsiijkii.— He' judiol qa yeku'ƚ iye: —Yekheweli'ƚ in ye'judioli'ƚ nite' ƚenexkeli'ƚij ye'm qu' hilani'ƚ pa'qu' jukhewe'.—
Aka'an in ƚunye'jkii qe qa' nafits kekhewe' ƚe'lijei ha' Jesús in iyetij qa yeqethenik'iha pa'n qu' ƚawamhinye'je' hatse'.
Ma' qa ha' Pilato qa uyifi iye kekhe' wititsi' pretorio, qa taya'yets ha' Jesús, ma' qa wetka'xetsji', qa yit'ijets: —¿Me hik akha' pakha' qi ƚatata ene' judiol?—
Ha' Jesús qa yeku'ƚ: —¿Me akha'ƚe qu' it'ij aka'an? ¿Me i'nƚi'i qu' nata'ƚƚe'ets qu' nit'ij ewets pekhewepe' qu' yakha'ye'?—
Ha' Pilato qa yeku'ƚ iye: —¿Ye' me yakha' ye'judio? Ene' ejefets qa nekhewe' iye tenek'enhe'yij ne' pa'il tseƚis ej. ¿Pa'n eqfenye'j ewek pa'aj?—

Ha' Jesús qa yeku'ƚ: —Na' heinek'enhe'yi' nite' ha'ne sehe' ipji'. Qe qek hik ha'neyi'i' ha'ne sehe' ipji' na' heinek'enhe'yi', ma' qa nekhewe' tsijayan qekha nawatlantaxyipji', qekha nite' niwejinetaxij ne' judiol in t'eku'myi'. Qa nite'ƚe hik ha'ne i'ni'in nakha' heinek'enheiji'.—

Ma' qa ha' Pilato qa yit'ijets: —¿Ye' me akha' e'wittata?— Ha' Jesús qa yeku'ƚ iye: —Ƚ'asiinik'iha ka' ƚit'ij in yakha' ye'wittata. Qa hik ta'ƚijupi' in tsekfik'i qa hik ta'ƚijupi' iye in tsametsju' ha'ne sehe' ipji', qe qa' henfel na' yijaa'ija. Qa week nekhewe' hats i'nji'teje'm na' yijaa'ija, qa tek'en yiwets.—
Ha' Pilato qa yit'ij: —¿Pakhana's qu' ƚunye'je'kii pa' yijaa'ija?— In yit'ij aka'an, ma' qa uyetsfik'i iye hekhewe' judiol, qa yit'ijji'ju': —Ham hi'wene' pa'qu' uƚ'axe' qu' ƚunye'je' hakha'an.

Qa na'lƚe ka' hayiits eqfenyejeijii'ƚ ewek qu' yakha'ye' qu' hiwejinji'ij pa'qu' ewi'ƚe' wit'opheƚik'e' qa yamji'jets ene' ƚe'sits neƚutsji' Pascua. ¿Me ƚisu'uni'ƚ qu' hiwejin ha'ne qi ƚatata ne' judiol?—
Ma' qa ewi'ƚij iye in week tayai wetju'ƚ, qa yit'ijju': —¡Hasu'uj iwejin nakha'an! Hakha' yijat'ij Barrabás qu' iwejin.— Ha' Barrabás hikha' qi in uƚ'ax ejtenhetsax.
